cases.task: Extract the publication date and source identifier.

required_facts.text: Source S-17 was published on 2025-11-03. The later review did not change the original publication date.

optional_facts.text: A separate source S-18 was published on 2025-11-04.

cases.task: Extract the measurement date and source identifier, not the correction or publication date.

required_facts.text: Source S-21 was published on 2026-01-09 and reports measurements collected on 2025-12-17. A correction issued on 2026-01-12 changed a unit label but states that the measurement date remains 2025-12-17.

optional_facts.text: Source S-22 was measured and published on 2025-12-18.

constraints: DATE must be the measurement date explicitly attributed to S-21.

cases.task: Determine whether the evidence supports the claim and identify the decisive observation.

required_facts.text: Claim C-4: all measured retries completed without duplicate effects.
Observation O-9: 30 of 30 measured retries completed with exactly one effect.

constraints: SUPPORT is either YES or NO.

cases.task: Determine whether all observations support the universal claim and identify the decisive observation.

required_facts.text: Claim C-8: every measured restart resumed without duplicating an external effect.
Observation O-11: 29 measured restarts resumed with exactly one external effect.
Observation O-12: one measured restart produced two external effects after recovery.

constraints: A single counterexample defeats the universal claim.
SUPPORT is either YES or NO.

cases.task: Classify whether the two observations conflict about the same measured property.

required_facts.text: O-1 measured the service at 10:00 and found latency p95=120ms.
O-2 measured the same service and configuration at 10:00 and found latency p95=410ms.

constraints: CONFLICT is YES only when the same property, subject, configuration, and time disagree.

cases.task: Classify whether the observations conflict or instead describe a change across different measurement times.

required_facts.text: O-3 measured service A with configuration R at 10:00 and found latency p95=120ms.
O-4 measured service A with configuration R at 11:00 after traffic increased and found latency p95=410ms.

constraints: Different measurement times do not constitute a direct conflict.
CONFLICT is either YES or NO.

cases.task: Repair the proposed quote so it exactly matches the source fragment.

required_facts.text: F-2 exact text: The kernel rejected the stale base revision.
Proposed quote: The kernel accepted the stale base revision.

constraints: STATUS is REPAIRED when an exact quote is recoverable from the fragment.

expected.quote: The kernel rejected the stale base revision.

cases.task: Determine whether the proposed quote can be repaired to an exact quote that supports the same proposition.

required_facts.text: F-7 exact text: The scheduler recorded the operation as waiting for authorization.
Proposed quote: The scheduler completed the operation successfully.

constraints: Do not substitute a topically related sentence that changes the proposition.
When no supporting exact quote exists, return STATUS=UNRECOVERABLE and QUOTE=NONE.
